notes: Site: panemirates.com redirects to www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/ (ScandiPWA/Magento 2, Al Seer Group). Access: tier 1 (curl_cffi) and tier 2 (Playwright) both blocked by a Cloudflare Managed Challenge; robots.txt disallows ALL agents generically (no Claude-specific block), so proceeded to tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome), which passed the challenge. Main nav has no direct 'New Arrivals' item. Typed 'new arrivals' into the site's own search box; autocomplete returned several tag-style suggestion chips (New premium, Newfield, New arrival, New bone, New seater) -- notably normalizing my plural query to the singular 'New arrival', a different exact string than typed, which rules out the chip being a blind echo of the query. Clicked 'New arrival' -> navigated to https://www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/search/new%20arrival with breadcrumb 'Home > New Arrival', on-page H1 'NEW ARRIVAL', a full PLP shell (Color/Discount range/Features/Categories filters, sort, grid/list toggle) and a site-reported count of 634 items; scrolled the grid and confirmed real, fully-loaded product tiles render (not an empty/placeholder state). Ran a negative-control search for a nonsense string ('xyzqwerty123') which correctly returned '0 items' / 'We are sorry! There were no products found', confirming the /search/<term> mechanism performs genuine matching against a real backing collection rather than always returning a themed page -- so the New Arrival result is a real tagged merchandising collection, not a coincidental keyword hit. Some of the top-ranked items in the New Arrival listing were 'Brendon Stretchfit ... Sofa Cover New ...' products, where 'New' appears in a size-label token in the product name rather than obviously in a 'recently added' sense; I could not independently confirm recency (no date-added field was exposed), so I flag light residual uncertainty in-row even though the page passes the structural/PLP tests (real breadcrumb, distinct H1, distinct item count from Bestsellers/Clearance, dedicated filter set). Single undifferentiated listing across departments; Categories is a filter, not separate child pages -- one row only. No PDP crawling performed.
